slice_cache_prefill: slice the KV cache by batch and sequence length for the prefill stage
get_cache_total_length: get the total cache length from the key tensor shape of the first layer
set_cache_end_index: set the end index value across all layers of the KV cache
check_cache_is_full: check whether the cache end index has reached the maximum cache length
set_kv_at_slice: set KV cache values at a specific batch and sequence slice using cache.at
